name: 74LVC1G332DBVRG4
title: SN74LVC1G332: single 3-input positive-OR gate, 1.65 V to 5.5 V
summary: A single three-input OR gate in the LVC family: Y is high when any of A, B or C is high. It runs from 1.65 V to 5.5 V, its inputs take up to 5.5 V at any supply so it can step a signal down to VCC, and the output sinks or sources 24 mA at 3.3 V. Ioff keeps the output off with the supply removed, for partial power-down and live insertion. Offered in SOT-23 (DBV), SC70 (DCK), SOT-5X3 (DRL), USON (DRY), X2SON (DSF) and the bare-die DSBGA (YZP); 74LVC1G332DBVRG4 is the SOT-23 part on a 3000-piece reel.

equations.name: Logic function
equations.expr: Y = A + B + C = NOT(NOT A · NOT B · NOT C)

operation.text: The output is high if one or more of A, B and C is high, and low only with all three low.

Inputs tolerate up to 5.5 V regardless of supply, which supports down translation of a higher-voltage input to VCC. An input held at VCC - 0.6 V rather than at a rail draws up to 500 µA extra supply current (ΔICC, VCC 3 V to 5.5 V).

With VCC at 0 V the Ioff circuit turns the output off, so no harmful current flows back into the part from a powered bus; inputs and output leak at most ±10 µA at 5.5 V in that state. This allows live insertion, partial power-down and back-drive.
No input may float: tie each unused input to VCC or to GND.
Input rise and fall rates should stay at or below 20 ns/V at 1.8 V and 2.5 V supplies, and 10 ns/V at 3.3 V and 5 V.
The part's internal ESD protection is limited. Keep its leads shorted together, or keep it in conductive foam, while it is stored or handled, to protect the MOS gates from static.
YZP is a NanoFree package: the die serves as the package.

Every orderable part with a listed rating is moisture sensitivity level 1 at 260 °C peak reflow. Body dimensions exclude mold flash and protrusions, at most 0.25 mm per side on DBV and 0.15 mm per side on DCK and DRL. On DBV, leads 1 to 3 may be wider than leads 4 to 6 to mark orientation. DBV follows JEDEC MO-178, DCK falls within MO-203 variation AB, DRL follows MO-293 variation UAAD and DSF follows MO-287 variation X2AAF.
